model_annotations.Bulgarian: This bar chart compares the accuracy (in percentage) of six different reinforcement learning algorithms—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO—across three benchmark domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at 2% intervals. Each domain on the horizontal axis features a grouped set of six bars, each corresponding to one algorithm and distinguished by color and pattern as indicated in the legend. In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves ~56.1%, DAPO ~53.2%, SRPO ~55.8%, GRPO ~53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection ~54.5%, and PPO ~53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches ~57.0%, DAPO ~55.9%, SRPO ~57.2%, GRPO ~55.8%, PPO+Self-reflection ~56.2%, and PPO ~54.7%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection leads at ~60.9%, followed by SRPO at ~60.6%, GRPO at ~58.2%, DAPO at ~57.6%, PPO+Self-reflection at ~59.1%, and PPO at ~57.0%. The bars are not sorted by height within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern coding. The chart suggests that DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO generally perform best across domains, particularly in Physics.
